name: Pioneer DDJ-FLX10
author: Reboxed
description: 4-deck controller with stems. Pad modes HOT CUE, PAD FX 1/2, BEAT JUMP, BEAT LOOP, SAMPLER, KEYBOARD, KEY SHIFT (16 hot cues), MEMORY CUE CALL, ACTIVE PART, PART ISOLATOR, FX PART SELECT on the Beat FX channel, SAMPLER VOLUME / CUE, BEAT GRID ADJUST / SLIDE with the jog. The manufacturer's mapping has the jog, channel fader, crossfader and FX ON rows commented out: they are enabled here. Not yet tried on the hardware: report problems with the MIDI monitor (Preferences > MIDI).
